title: The Lantern Glass That Needed a Wipe
youtube_title: The Lantern Glass That Needed a Wipe | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Helping without being asked is a quiet sort of brave.
summary: At a harbor step where parcels change hands, a lantern glass smudged with fingerprints is awkward for one person. Tala notices Papa struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
